svg.title: CALMS
svg.desc: CALMS. A lens for assessing a DevOps adoption: culture, automation, lean, measurement and sharing, and the dimension that holds the others back. Step 1, Tools without change: A new pipeline and a renamed DevOps team, yet releases stay monthly and incidents end in blame. Step 2, Five dimensions, scored: Both sides score with evidence: culture 2, automation 4, lean 2, measurement 3, sharing 1. Step 3, Start with the weakest: Actions start with sharing and culture; six months on: culture 3, lean 3, measurement 4, sharing 3. Step 4, Pitfalls and misuse: Pitfalls: ranking teams by score, automation only, a DevOps silo, hidden numbers and no follow-up.
